tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Search the npm registry by name or keywords. Returns matching packages with a link to their full npmscan.com risk/analysis page.

tools.name: get_package
tools.description: Fetch npm registry metadata for a package: latest version, install scripts (preinstall/postinstall are a key risk signal), maintainers, license, and recent version history. Includes a link to the full npmscan.com analysis page.

tools.name: get_package_version
tools.description: Fetch registry metadata for one exact version of a package (dependencies, install scripts, tarball). Use this to check a version pinned in a lockfile rather than the latest release.

tools.name: query_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Query OSV.dev for known vulnerabilities affecting an npm package, optionally scoped to one version. Use before recommending or installing a package.

tools.name: batch_query_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Query OSV.dev for known vulnerabilities across up to 100 npm packages at once — ideal for scanning a whole package.json/lockfile in one call.

tools.name: get_latest_advisories
tools.description: Browse recently published, reviewed GitHub Security Advisories for the npm ecosystem. Filter by severity, vulnerability category (XSS, SQL/NoSQL Injection, SSRF, Access Control, Code Injection, etc.), an affected package name, or look up one exact advisory by GHSA or CVE ID.
